models.closure: Freeze completed living P,Q,diet,predation,accumulation,migration. Solve EE for SM; detritus accumulation absorbs routed inflow at fixed predation. No new consumption is assumed.
models.group_identity_source: UTF-8 frozen JSON group_seq/group_name; immutable numeric sequence.

metadata.description:
Base model from Hoover at al 2012 combined with  Ballerini et al  (2014) and Cornejo- Donoso and Antezana 2008 
            Functional  groups reflect  a meshing of all three models
            Biomasses updated to better reflect late 1990s
            P/Q ratios calculated following Ballerini et  al method
            P/B values updated from the  literature
            Diet matrices updated formt the literature and  modified to make the model balance
metadata.author: Dahood, A
metadata.reference: Dahood, A., de Mutsert, K., and Watters, G.M. (2020). Evaluating Antarctic marine protected area sce

models.native_time_unit: not explicitly recorded in this JSON metadata; no annual reconstruction or cross-model absolute aggregation
models.native_area_unit: not explicitly recorded by currency enum

physical.balance_tolerance: 1e-4 group-relative living/consumption and whole; 1e-7 absolute detritus; original rounding residuals preserved

warnings: 3 group(s) have TE=0 because EE=0 (M0=p): 17 (Flying Birds), 7 (Sperm Whales), 1 (Killer whales). Their consumed PP is re-credited to detritus (fix_EE_0_cases=True) so the TE SPPR stays PP-balanced.

5 group(s) have near-zero TE (0 < EE << 1): 24 (Salps), 15 (Adelie Penguins), 12 (Emperor Penguins), 10 (Minke Whales), 4 (Crabeater Seal). Their SPPR is near-singular (inherent to the TE method); the detritus SPPR may be inflated and is not corrected by fix_EE_0_cases.

limitations: Numerical eligibility does not establish ecological truth or global representativeness.
Existing JSON metadata establishes natural detritus fate; no fleet discard-return destination was extracted.
Detritus export is excluded from fishery H by the unchanged loader; detritus accumulation remains the dependent residual.
Native currency WetWeight; missing area/time normalization stays unknown.
models.baseline_validation: Fresh unmodified frozen calculator + zero-discard adapter equality, independent analytic and conservation checks; no saved workbook required.
